note: NOT here: restoring the four missing digits of the truncated two-pi (6.28318530718 vs 6.283185307179586).  Tried, and it SURVIVED: the two constants differ by 4.1e-13, adjacent floats near 6.28 are 4.8e-7 apart, so no float phase can sit between them for the comparison and the subtraction's difference vanishes when the result narrows to float.  The literal is established by the 8-byte constant at .rodata.cst8+0x1d8 -- the author's own digits -- and rests on the disassembly, not on behaviour.

note: NOT here: reassociating the biquad's feed sum.  The first attempt (`*buf + c[1]*z2 + c[2]*z1`) merely COMMUTES the first addition, which is exact -- an equivalent mutant, withdrawn.  A true reassociation (`c[1]*z2 + (*buf + c[2]*z1)`) is then shielded the same way as the reciprocal tails in the beepgen file: extended-precision intermediates make the ordering difference ~2^-64 relative, invisible after the narrowing store for any same-scale input.  The source order matches the object's fadd sequence and is carried by the disassembly.
